pages.text: After discovering the most hidden of necromantic ways, you've devised a new set of garb to showcase your mastery over the dark arts.
The set functions the same as the old Necro Set with some improvements and does not give the wearer debuffs when under sunlight.

pages.title: Changing Colors
pages.text: You can also change the color of either of your Crown or Cape's gems and trimmings by right-clicking a Haunted Mirror with a dye while holding it offhand. To remove the custom color, right-click the mirror with a bucket of water also while holding it offhand.
